observation.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost/c/token -d 'grant_type=password&username=admin&password=Harbor12345' | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[^=]*=//'); curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/api/v2.0/systeminfo > /tmp/si.json; grep -c . /tmp/si.json; grep -oE '"harbor_version":[^,}]*' /tmp/si.json; echo '--- repos now ---'; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'http://localhost/api/v2.0/projects/library/repositories' | grep -oE '"name":"[^"]*"'; echo '--- artifacts of validation-test repo ---'; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'http://localhost/api/v2.0/projects/library/repositories/alpine/artifacts?page_size=10' | grep -oE '"tag":"[^"]*"'
